whoami.heading: Fixing tracking data where it actually breaks
whoami.bio1: I'm a tracking specialist based in Normandy, France. I help e-commerce brands recover lost conversion signals and act as an on-demand technical partner for growth agencies.
whoami.bio2: Instead of just pasting basic GTM scripts, I write custom JavaScript data layers, plug into payment webhooks like Stripe, and route clean server-side data using Addingwell and Sirdata.
